correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive reconstruction: f=(1,16,80,144,80), 80-facet pure shelling independently validated for every required earlier facet, reduced Euler characteristic -1 and hence a single S3 wedge summand. Link orbits exhaust all 321 faces, with top-only ranks 1 or 2 over primes 2 and 3; pure shellability of each link upgrades to integral torsion-freeness and precise ranks. The rank-2 faces form one 32-triangle torus with 16 vertices, 48 edges, closed-manifold links, connectivity, coherent integral orientation and Euler characteristic zero. All pointwise homology follows from link shift; no finite sample extrapolation.

value.rationale: A canonical smallest shellable but not vertex-decomposable circulant has global homotopy S3 while failing the homology-manifold property along an entire embedded torus. The full local rank stratification and intrinsic surface identification explain topological features not reflected in standard shellability, Cohen–Macaulay or global Betti classifications. The exact 16-vertex locus is natural, complete, non-arbitrary and supports further study of local topological singularities in flag complexes.
